newsitem.title: USA: Coastal shuts in U.S. Gulf production.
newsitem.headline: Coastal shuts in U.S. Gulf production.

text.p: Coastal Corp shut in an offshore Gulf of Mexico well producing less than 1,000 barrels of oil per day from a Eugene Island platform off the Louisiana coast in the path of Tropical Storm Danny on Thursday, a spokesman said.

The Houston-based oil and gas company also evacuated a drilling rig in the West Cameron section of the central Gulf and pulled non-essential workers off other platforms in the storm's path as a precaution, spokesman Brian Mitchell said.
Danny stormed through the central Gulf Thursday and was expected to make landfall early Friday along the Louisiana coast.
